haikus.haiku:
Soft banana curls
Ve-lvet ice cream warm sighs bright
Cherry tops sparkle
Happy #NationalBananaSplitDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Amber glass glows bright
Citrus mist soft rises slow
Warm heart sings with joy
Happy #NationalWhiskey

Soft light falls on cake
Crimson candles glow like stars
Joy drips in sweet smiles
#HappyBirthdayAltheaGibson from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright candle soft swirls
Melody rises like dawn
Joy drifts through soft halls
#HappyBirthdayLeonardBernstein from @ClamBakeSanta
